sets.relationshipLabel: worker and the tool of their trade
sets.explanation: A sound engineer works a mixing board the same way a lighting designer works a rig — each role names its one essential instrument.

sets.relationshipLabel: collection and the kind of thing it is made of
sets.explanation: A campground is just its tents and a market row is just its stalls — the whole is nothing but many of the part.

sets.relationshipLabel: place and what it exists to produce
sets.explanation: Each place is defined by the single product it was set up to deliver — tacos from the truck, beer from the tent.

sets.relationshipLabel: start and end of one span
sets.explanation: A show ends as an encore and hype ends as exhaustion — both pairs trace the same arc from opening to burnout.
